title: MyStore Admin Dashboard
description: A production-ready admin dashboard for managing products, orders, inventory, payments, customers, analytics, and business operations for a full-stack e-commerce platform.
lgdescription:
I built MyStore Admin Dashboard to understand how real-world e-commerce businesses manage products, inventory, orders, customers, payments, analytics, and promotional content from a centralized platform. Instead of creating a basic CRUD application, I focused on implementing practical business workflows such as secure admin authentication with Google Authenticator (2FA), email notifications, customer insights, payment processing, invoice generation, and cloud-based file management.

Throughout this project, I worked on solving real development challenges while building a responsive and maintainable application using modern web technologies. The experience helped me gain hands-on knowledge of authentication, API design, payment workflows, cloud storage, business reporting, and the architectural decisions involved in developing a complete e-commerce administration system.
overview: MyStore Admin Dashboard is a full-stack administration platform built to manage products, categories, inventory, orders, customers, payments, analytics, and promotional content for an e-commerce business. The project includes mobile-first responsive design, secure admin authentication with Google 2FA, email notifications, customer insights, shop hero banner management, and payment workflows. The primary goal of this project was to understand and implement real-world e-commerce business operations, security practices, and administrative workflows.

backend.overview: Custom REST API powering both the Admin Dashboard and Shop frontend applications.

problem: Managing an e-commerce business manually becomes difficult as products, orders, customers, payments, and inventory grow. I wanted to build a centralized admin system that could handle day-to-day business operations securely and efficiently.
solution: Built a full-stack admin dashboard and backend ecosystem that provides secure authentication, product and order management, payment processing, invoice generation, analytics, and administrative tools in a single platform.

challenges.problem: Creating professional PDF invoices that looked clean, readable, and suitable for real customer orders.
challenges.solution: Built custom invoice templates using pdfkit and pdfkit-table, carefully designing the layout, product tables, pricing information, taxes, and customer details.

challenges.problem: Generating invoices only after successful payment verification and order creation.
challenges.solution: Implemented a server-side workflow that verifies payments, creates orders, generates invoices automatically, sends them by email, and makes them available for download.

challenges.problem: Implementing secure authentication without exposing tokens in the browser.
challenges.solution: Used JWT authentication with HttpOnly cookies instead of storing tokens in localStorage to improve security and reduce token exposure risks.

challenges.problem: Managing product image uploads, updates, and cleanup efficiently.
challenges.solution: Integrated Multer and Cloudinary and implemented automatic cleanup using Cloudinary public IDs when products or images were deleted.

learning: How to implement secure authentication using JWT, HttpOnly cookies, and Google Authenticator (2FA).
How payment verification workflows work after successful transactions.
How to generate and deliver PDF invoices automatically.
How to organize a growing backend using routes, controllers, services, and middleware.
How to manage file uploads, updates, and cleanup using Cloudinary.
How to build and consume REST APIs for real-world business workflows.
How to implement email notifications and transactional email systems.
How to write and test API endpoints using Supertest and MongoDB Memory Server.
How to deploy and optimize applications using serverless platforms.
How challenging it is to keep a full-stack application maintainable as new features are added.
futureImprovements: Role-based access control with different admin permissions
Real-time notifications for orders and system updates
Activity logs and audit history for admin actions
More detailed analytics and business reports

title: MyAZStore Shop
description: A modern full-stack e-commerce shopping platform where users can discover products, manage their wishlist and cart, securely place orders, download invoices, and track purchases from any device.
lgdescription:
I built MyAZStore Shop to understand how modern e-commerce websites provide a complete shopping experience from product discovery to order delivery. Instead of focusing only on product listings, I wanted to build a customer-facing platform that supports secure authentication, product search, wishlist management, shopping cart, checkout, online payments, order history, invoice generation, and email notifications.

Throughout this project, I focused on creating a responsive, mobile-first shopping experience that feels fast, simple, and easy to use across different devices. Building this application helped me gain practical experience with customer workflows, payment processing, API integration, state management, cloud storage, Progressive Web App (PWA) features, and building a complete e-commerce frontend powered by a shared backend.
overview: MyAZStore Shop is a full-stack e-commerce shopping platform where users can browse products, search and filter items, manage their wishlist and cart, complete secure online payments, download invoices, and track orders. The application is built with a mobile-first responsive design, PWA support, OTP-based authentication, email notifications, and a shared backend that powers both the customer storefront and the admin dashboard.

backend.overview: The shop frontend shares a common REST API with the MyStore Admin Dashboard, allowing both applications to work together using the same products, customers, orders, payments, and inventory.

problem: Online shopping should be simple, fast, and secure, but building a complete customer experience involves much more than displaying products. I wanted to create a shopping platform where users could easily discover products, manage their wishlist and cart, place secure orders, receive email notifications, download invoices, and track their purchases from a single application.
solution: Built a full-stack e-commerce storefront that provides product browsing, advanced search and filtering, wishlist management, shopping cart, secure OTP authentication, Razorpay payment integration, address management, order tracking, PDF invoice downloads, email notifications, and Progressive Web App support using a shared backend with the admin dashboard.

challenges.problem: Keeping the wishlist and shopping cart available only for authenticated users while maintaining a smooth shopping experience.
challenges.solution: Protected wishlist and cart operations using JWT authentication with HttpOnly cookies and prompted users to sign in whenever authentication was required.

challenges.problem: Creating a complete checkout workflow that handled addresses, payment verification, order creation, and invoice generation.
challenges.solution: Implemented a multi-step checkout process that validates user information, verifies Razorpay payments on the server, creates the order, generates the invoice, and sends confirmation emails automatically.

challenges.problem: Providing users with order updates without requiring them to repeatedly check their account.
challenges.solution: Integrated email notifications for order confirmation, invoice delivery, and order status updates to keep customers informed throughout the purchase process.

challenges.problem: Building a shopping experience that worked well across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
challenges.solution: Designed the application with a mobile-first responsive approach and optimized layouts, navigation, and interactions for different screen sizes.

learning: How to build a complete customer shopping experience from product discovery to order delivery.
How OTP-based authentication improves account security while keeping the login process simple.
How shopping carts, wishlists, and checkout workflows work together in a real e-commerce application.
How payment verification should be handled securely before creating customer orders.
How to generate and deliver PDF invoices automatically after successful purchases.
How to implement email notifications for order confirmations and status updates.
How to build responsive user interfaces using a mobile-first approach.
How Progressive Web Apps improve accessibility and usability across different devices.
How a shared backend can efficiently power both customer and admin applications.
How important performance, usability, and user experience are in an e-commerce platform.
futureImprovements: Product recommendations based on browsing history

title: Find Movie
description: A modern movie discovery platform featuring trending movies, TV shows, search functionality, detailed media information, favorites management, and a responsive user experience with optimized performance and SEO.
lgdescription: FindMovie is a modern full-stack movie and TV discovery platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Mongoose, NextAuth, TanStack Query, Zod, Framer Motion, and the TMDb API. The platform allows users to discover trending and popular movies and TV shows, search for specific titles, explore detailed media information, and save content to their personal favorites. The application uses Next.js server-side architecture for secure API communication with TMDb while MongoDB and Mongoose provide persistent storage for user-related data such as favorites. Authentication is handled through NextAuth, while TanStack Query manages asynchronous data fetching and caching. Zod provides schema-based validation, and Framer Motion adds smooth interface animations. The application was designed with a responsive, mobile-first interface, reusable components, optimized media loading, and SEO in mind.
overview: FindMovie is a modern movie and TV discovery platform built to provide a fast, responsive, and engaging experience for discovering movies and television shows. The application integrates the TMDb API for media data while using Next.js server-side architecture to handle API communication securely. Users can explore trending and popular content, search for movies and TV shows, view detailed media information, and manage their favorite content. The platform was designed with a strong focus on reusable component architecture, type safety, responsive UX, performance, and SEO.

backend.overview: A Next.js-based backend architecture supporting authentication, favorites management, data validation, MongoDB persistence, and secure communication with the TMDb API.

engineeringHighlights: Built a full-stack movie discovery platform using Next.js App Router and TypeScript
Integrated TMDb API for movie and TV content discovery
Implemented user authentication using NextAuth
Built favorites management with MongoDB and Mongoose
Created reusable TypeScript media models supporting both movies and TV shows
Integrated TanStack Query for data fetching, caching, and asynchronous state management
Implemented schema-based request validation using Zod
Created reusable components for media cards, media rows, search, filters, metadata, and hero sections
Used Framer Motion to create smooth and responsive interface animations
Implemented server-side API communication to protect external API credentials
Designed the application with a mobile-first responsive architecture
Implemented SEO-focused metadata and page structure
Deployed the application using Vercel serverless infrastructure
problem: Movie discovery platforms often contain large amounts of content but can provide a cluttered or inefficient browsing experience. Users also need a convenient way to discover movies and TV shows, search for specific content, view detailed information, and save interesting titles for later. Additionally, directly exposing external API credentials from the browser creates security concerns. I wanted to build a modern movie platform that solved these problems while maintaining strong performance, responsive design, and SEO.
solution: Built a full-stack movie and TV discovery platform using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, and the TMDb API. Implemented secure authentication with NextAuth, persistent favorites using MongoDB and Mongoose, server-side API communication, TanStack Query for efficient data management, Zod validation, and reusable responsive components for discovery and detailed media experiences.

challenges.problem: Direct requests to the TMDb API were unreliable in the local development environment due to regional network restrictions.
challenges.solution: Implemented server-side API communication through the Next.js application so the frontend could communicate through the application's own API layer instead of directly requesting TMDb from the browser.

challenges.problem: The application needed to support both movies and TV shows while maintaining a consistent UI architecture.
challenges.solution: Created normalized TypeScript media models and reusable components so movies and TV shows could share common rendering, filtering, and interaction patterns.

challenges.problem: Users needed a persistent way to save movies and TV shows they wanted to watch later.
challenges.solution: Implemented authentication with NextAuth and built a MongoDB/Mongoose persistence layer for managing user favorites.

challenges.problem: Managing asynchronous data across trending sections, search results, filters, and detail pages could lead to duplicated fetching logic.
challenges.solution: Created reusable API service functions and integrated TanStack Query for caching, request management, loading states, and data synchronization.

challenges.problem: Movie and TV API responses contain different structures and optional fields.
challenges.solution: Created dedicated TypeScript interfaces and normalized media types to provide consistent data structures across the application while maintaining strict type safety.

challenges.problem: Detail pages required different metadata while maintaining a consistent responsive interface.
challenges.solution: Separated the detail-page UI into reusable components for hero sections, metadata, genres, ratings, and additional media information.

challenges.problem: Large movie posters and backdrop images could negatively affect loading performance.
challenges.solution: Implemented responsive image rendering and optimized media layouts to reduce unnecessary image overhead while maintaining visual quality.

challenges.problem: The application needed to remain usable while API requests were loading or failed.
challenges.solution: Implemented skeleton loading states, error handling, empty states, and controlled asynchronous UI states across the application.

learning: Building production-style applications with Next.js App Router
Designing full-stack applications using Next.js
Integrating and consuming third-party REST APIs
Working with the TMDb API and complex media data
Implementing authentication using NextAuth
Persisting user data using MongoDB and Mongoose
Building favorites and personalized user features
Using TanStack Query for asynchronous data management and caching
Implementing schema validation using Zod
Designing reusable TypeScript architectures for multiple media types
Building responsive media-heavy interfaces
Using Framer Motion for UI animations
Optimizing applications for performance and SEO
Deploying full-stack Next.js applications using Vercel

title: Luman Studio – Interactive Storytelling Website
description: Luman Studio is a high-end, animation-driven frontend experience built to showcase acoustic design solutions through immersive storytelling, smooth interactions, and a premium responsive interface.
lgdescription: Luman Studio is an interactive storytelling website designed to present acoustic design solutions through a visually immersive digital experience. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, the platform focuses on smooth transitions, animation-driven storytelling, responsive layouts, and optimized image rendering. The experience uses reusable components and modern frontend architecture to create a premium presentation across desktop and mobile devices.
overview: Luman Studio is a premium interactive website focused on presenting acoustic design solutions through visual storytelling. The project combines responsive layouts, smooth animations, optimized imagery, and reusable React components to create an engaging browsing experience.

backend.overview: Luman Studio is primarily a frontend-focused interactive experience without a dedicated custom backend.

engineeringHighlights: Built a premium interactive storytelling experience using Next.js and React
Implemented animation-driven UI interactions using Framer Motion
Created reusable TypeScript and React components
Designed responsive layouts for desktop and mobile experiences
Implemented optimized image rendering using Next.js Image Optimization
Used Tailwind CSS for scalable responsive styling
Focused on immersive visual storytelling and smooth interaction design
Deployed the production application using Vercel
problem: Traditional studio websites can present design solutions as static content, making it difficult to communicate the visual quality and atmosphere of premium acoustic design work. The project needed a more immersive way to present the studio and its solutions while maintaining responsive performance across devices.
solution: Built an animation-driven interactive storytelling website using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. The interface combines visual storytelling, smooth transitions, responsive layouts, reusable components, and optimized imagery to create a premium digital presentation.

challenges.problem: The website needed to communicate premium acoustic design work through an immersive digital experience rather than a conventional static layout.
challenges.solution: Designed the interface around visual storytelling, interactive sections, animation, and carefully structured content presentation.

challenges.problem: Heavy visual content and animations could negatively affect the browsing experience on smaller devices.
challenges.solution: Implemented responsive layouts and optimized image rendering using Next.js Image Optimization.

challenges.problem: Multiple interactive sections needed consistent animation behavior without duplicating implementation logic.
challenges.solution: Used reusable React components and Framer Motion patterns to maintain consistent interaction behavior.

challenges.problem: The experience needed to remain visually rich while adapting to different screen sizes.
challenges.solution: Built the interface using responsive Tailwind CSS layouts with mobile and desktop considerations throughout the component architecture.

learning: Building interactive storytelling experiences with Next.js
Creating animation-driven interfaces with Framer Motion
Designing premium responsive frontend experiences
Structuring reusable React and TypeScript components
Working with Next.js Image Optimization
Balancing visual animation with frontend performance
Designing responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS
Deploying production frontend applications using Vercel
